summary: A Google DeepMind executive posted that Gemini Spark, a feature enabling Gemini to perform tasks like adding calendar events from a PDF, is now live for Google AI Pro subscribers in the US and expanding globally.

practices.reason: The post describes an agentic task-completion use case but gives no benchmark or specific performance detail beyond a single anecdote.
practices.quote: Tell Gemini to add every "No School" day to your Google Calendar. Done.
